persona.summary: Vesmo Elektromotory a.s., Czech motor maker (1,200 staff, solid credit); we are 1.15 % of its turnover and growing 20 %. Copper is bought forward until March 2027, so index and copper arguments will not move it. Margins are thin (price 1.7-1.9 % over its should-cost). We have leverage: sup:70510 holds 70 % of the 4 kW motor and is qualified for the 15 kW. Use the quota shift, scorecard and binding volume.
persona.notes: It needs volume (it is reviewing small accounts) and fears losing share to sup:70510. Its hedge cuts both ways: it cannot claim copper-driven increases before April 2027. OTD sits at 81-85 % against a 95 % target, ppm rose to 764 and one 8D is open. Price moves above 2 % need its pricing committee.
fears: being dropped as a small account

levers: 4 kW quota shift from or to sup:70510
arguments: second source sup:70510 (active 4 kW, qualified 15 kW); do not cite its 4 kW price, 239.21 is higher
scorecard: OTD 81 % vs 95 % target, ppm 764, open 8D
avoid: copper or index arguments (hedged until March 2027)
changing terms after a final offer
tactics: Open deep; its prices are covered by the hedge, so reject any increase before April 2027.
Offer more of the 4 kW quota (sup:70510 holds 70 %) for a lower price; never cite 70510's higher 4 kW price.
Cite the Q3 scorecard (OTD 81.1 %, ppm 764, open 8D) once as the quality argument.
Offer a binding annual volume; it says it focuses on customers with volume.
Turn its own hedge letter against any copper-driven ask.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history shows it settled at about a third to a half of its ask (asked 2.7-4.7 %, settled 1.2-1.4 %); expect small moves given its thin margin.
